title: Farming shops
html:
Farming shops

Farming shops are a type of store throughout Gielinor. The stores are represented by a icon. The majority of farming shops sell tools that players need to start Farming, while some sell seeds. There are 13 Farming shops in Old School RuneScape. Most are located near an allotment farming patch.

Farmers

[edit | edit source]

In addition to the shops, there are also single farmers who will look after your farming patches. They sell an unlimited number of farming-related items, and are located at all farming patches except special ones.
